subject: Stakeholder onboarding and evaluation roles — roadmap & success metrics
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novagen.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder onboarding and evaluation roles — roadmap & success metrics

Hi Samira — thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I outlined a short roadmap and proposed owners so we can get the Novagen evaluation moving the week of Nov 22. Goals: validate latency & accuracy against your clinical QA prompts, confirm integration patterns for your staging dataset, and agree on success criteria for a potential pilot.

Quick ask: please confirm the procurement contact who should be on the MAP (we'll need them for pricing and SOW timelines). Below are the proposed owners and an initial benchmark plan — happy to adjust.

Proposed owners (Redwood):
- Naomi Feldman — overall program owner, exec alignment, rollout policy
- Aditya Rao — sales lead, commercial terms, demo coordination
- Priyom Das — eval engineer lead, benchmark design, prompt ownership
- Marissa Cole — customer success, onboarding, QA sampling

Proposed external stakeholders (Novagen):
- Samira Khan — product lead (evaluation owner)
- Ethan Liu — technical lead (integration + dataset access)
- Procurement contact TBD — pricing & contract flow

Baseline benchmark plan (high level):
1) Prompt set: 200 clinical QA prompts provided by Novagen; split 70/30 train/eval.
2) Metrics: exact-match / F1 on gold labels, utterance-level response latency (p50/p95), hallucination audit on a 20% sample.
3) Thresholds for pilot: >= 0.82 macro-F1 on core dataset AND p95 latency < 600ms on dedicated instance.

Attachments: novagen_map_outline_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), evaluation_benchmarks_v3.md (detailed scoring rubric)

Next steps:
- Samira: confirm procurement contact + feedback on thresholds by Tue 11/17
- Priyom & Marissa: will schedule a 60-min technical sweep (dataset access, auth) for Nov 23
- Aditya: draft mutual-action timeline and pricing cadence after procurement contact is confirmed

If that all looks good I will share a calendar invite for Nov 23.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@novagen.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder onboarding and evaluation roles — roadmap & success metrics

Thanks Naomi — this looks great and aligned with what I was expecting. Apologies for the slow reply; I pulled in Ethan and copied our procurement alias (procurement@novagen.com). Procurement will be the formal contact for contracting, but I'll be the day-to-day evaluation owner.

Quick feedback on thresholds: the macro-F1 target looks reasonable for the initial vet. For latency, can we define measurement conditions? We'll be sending a 1k-token worst-case long-form prompt batch as part of the stress suite — would appreciate p95 for both short (<=128 tokens) and long (>=512 tokens) buckets.

Procurement point-of-contact: Melinda Park <melinda.park@novagen.com> (cc'd)

I'll also attach the Novagen prompt taxonomy so Priyom has a head start.

Thanks —
Samira
Samira Khan
Senior PM, Novagen Therapeutics
samira.k@novagen.com

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder onboarding and evaluation roles — roadmap & success metrics

Great — welcome Melinda. I've updated the MAP draft with procurement milestones and preliminary pricing windows; see HubSpot deal NB-4721 for line-item sketches. Naomi, I set the timeline in the sheet to reflect a two-week evaluation and one additional week for procurement review (target pilot start: 12/14).

On measurement buckets (Samira): good call. Priyom, can your team capture p95 separately for short/long prompt buckets and include memory/WAF considerations? Also, Priyom — would you be comfortable owning the primary prompt set curation and the bench execution? We expect Redwood to share a sanitized staging endpoint by Nov 23.

Action items:
- Priyom: own prompts + bench execution (deliver sample run on 11/25)
- Marissa: onboarding checklist & data access guide (deliver by 11/22)
- Naomi: confirm exec wrap and canary policy language for MAP (by 11/19)
- Melinda (Procurement): share preferred contract template and PO timelines

Links: MAP draft (Drive) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bNovagen-Eval

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder onboarding and evaluation roles — roadmap & success metrics

Forwarding a short scoring rubric and owner assignments I sketched for the bench (attached). Priyom, feel free to edit — I think splitting the prompt ownership by taxonomy buckets will keep evaluations focused and reduce cross-contamination.

Scoring rubric highlights (from evaluation_benchmarks_v3.md):
- Primary metrics: macro-F1, precision/recall on labeled slots, editorial hallucination rate (human-audited sample)
- Secondary metrics: token cost per standard prompt, end-to-end latency, error/retry rate under burst load
- Pass condition for pilot: macro-F1 >= 0.82 AND editorial hallucination rate <= 3% on audited sample

Owner assignments (proposed):
- Clinical prompts (diagnostics & recommendations): Priyom Das
- Integration & tooling validation (API + auth): Marissa Cole
- Long-form stress prompts: Priyom Das + Novagen engineering (Ethan)
- Commercial SLA / pricing exceptions: Aditya Rao

Attachments: evaluation_benchmarks_v3.md

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
